brief:
Settlers attacked a foreign solidarity activist and Palestinian civilians in Yatta, leaving multiple people injured, Shehab Wire reported. Video footage of the assault circulated online showed the confrontation between the settlers and residents of the southern West Bank town.

The attack is part of a broader pattern of settler violence in the Yatta area, where Palestinian communities face repeated incursions and assaults. Settlers have conducted numerous raids against the town in recent months, targeting both locals and international activists present to document conditions and provide protection to residents.

Yatta, located south of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, has been a flashpoint for settler aggression and Palestinian resistance. The incident underscores the ongoing security threats facing civilians and international observers operating in areas where Israeli settlements are expanding.
